reserve_policy.includes: known recurring Point + Production + Shared operating OPEX

opex_catalog.name: Сырьё
opex_catalog.note: Физическая закупка остаётся Production; экономически атрибутируется revenue cohort ровно один раз.

opex_catalog.name: Списания
opex_catalog.note: Каноническая доля от сырья, атрибутируемая cohort revenue без дублирования в Production.

opex_catalog.name: Потребительская упаковка
opex_catalog.note: Каноническая per-check mechanics торговой точки.

opex_catalog.name: ФОТ и взносы
opex_catalog.note: Historical integrated labour заменён доказуемыми point, production и one-manager planning projections; не делится пропорционально.

opex_catalog.name: Аренда
opex_catalog.note: Только contract-level occupancy дополнительных cohort; base rent остаётся в Base context.

opex_catalog.name: Эквайринг
opex_catalog.note: Канонические 2% gross revenue для каждой cohort.

opex_catalog.name: Комиссии агрегаторов
opex_catalog.note: Текущая approved cohort configuration имеет aggregator share = 0; при появлении share расчёт должен быть включён только для соответствующей cohort.

opex_catalog.name: Административный резерв
opex_catalog.note: 2% consolidated net revenue: Expansion получает только 2% своего incremental revenue, поэтому сеть не получает вторую копию base reserve.

opex_catalog.name: Маркетинг
opex_catalog.note: 2.4% net revenue атрибутируется point revenue; fixed 150k already belongs to Base and is not multiplied by points.

opex_catalog.name: Хозяйственные и эксплуатационные расходники
opex_catalog.note: Существующая formula 50k + 50k × checks/300 применяется к каждой additional point; Production portion already remains in Current Base rather than being copied twice.

opex_catalog.name: Коммунальные услуги
opex_catalog.note: Contract-level point utilities/service charges are used where supplied; this does not copy the historical integrated fixed amount.

opex_catalog.name: Обслуживание оборудования
opex_catalog.note: Regular service / minor repair scales from actual incremental point equipment assets relative to Current Base equipment and remains distinct from 3% maintenance CAPEX.

opex_catalog.name: Бухгалтерский аутсорсинг
opex_catalog.note: One 25k shared accounting function is already in Current Base. No unproven point multiplier is added for 5/9/13.

opex_catalog.name: Вентиляция и жироуловители
opex_catalog.note: Additional point line uses historical integrated amount per applicable m²; no venue contract confirms inclusion in service charge.

opex_catalog.name: Обновление спецодежды
opex_catalog.note: 15k historical line is calibrated per realistic roster employee and applied to additional point roster plus incremental prep-cook roster only.

opex_catalog.name: Музыка и права
opex_catalog.note: Street Seating receives the current line; takeaway is zero and Foodhall/Creative Cluster music is venue-provided.

opex_catalog.name: Pest control
opex_catalog.note: Additional physical points use the historical integrated calibration per applicable area; Current Base retains its production/base-premises portion.

opex_catalog.name: YUMA / кассовые сервисы
opex_catalog.note: Historical 6k stays in Current Base once; central versus per-point licensing is a confirmation-required assumption, not a calculated zero.

opex_catalog.name: Медосмотры и санитарные документы
opex_catalog.note: 5k historical line is calibrated per realistic food-operation roster employee and excludes the shared manager without a stated requirement.

opex_catalog.name: Пультовая охрана
opex_catalog.note: Recurring monitoring is distinct from launch video/alarm; venue-security-included Foodhall/Creative Cluster get zero, self-managed Street premises get the line.

opex_catalog.name: Банковское обслуживание
opex_catalog.note: 0 / TBD non-acquiring bank tariff remains a disclosed minor assumption gap, not a fabricated contract or a hidden zero.

opex_catalog.name: Прочие регулярные расходы
opex_catalog.note: Historical 66.5k catch-all remains one conservative Current Base/shared contingency; its unknown composition is not copied into Expansion.

issues.message: Мебель посадочного зала: Для расчёта мебели нужна площадь посадочного зала. Не включено в расчёт инвестиций до подтверждения исходного параметра.
YUMA / кассовые сервисы: Historical 6k stays in Current Base once; central versus per-point licensing is a confirmation-required assumption, not a calculated zero.
Банковское обслуживание: 0 / TBD non-acquiring bank tariff remains a disclosed minor assumption gap, not a fabricated contract or a hidden zero.
VAT assumption requires confirmation; the current Financial Model baseline remains the calculation input.
Требуется проверка мощности производства: спрос в portions/day рассчитан, но пропускная способность линии и вторая смена не имеют утверждённых параметров.
Vehicle maintenance is included in owned logistics OPEX; useful life for vehicle depreciation requires a separate policy decision and is not placed into the generic 3% maintenance formula.
Внешняя логистика на ранних открытиях: До перехода на owned logistics цена временной внешней развозки не задана; это rollout assumption, а не steady-state blocker сети из трёх и более точек.
